verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own Git Sync stores project data, which includes the collections, scripts and tests that make up its automations, in a Git repository, giving them git version control. It adds AI commit message suggestions and an in-app merge view for reviewing and resolving conflicts. However, the merge view covers conflict resolution rather than general change review, and no rollback or revert flow is documented. Missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of automations, a review workflow beyond merge-conflict resolution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Git Sync connects Insomnia directly to your Git repository. Your project data stays in your repository.
Insomnia opens a merge view so you can review and resolve conflicts without leaving the app.
AI commit message suggestions, which help maintain clear and atomic commit histories.
Collaboratively create APIs with an unlimited number of contributors (free accounts allow unlimited contributors on one project) and git version control.
